anima_powers: May use their animas to appear awesome and terrifying for a time.
May use their animas to burn the bodies of the dead and to do aggravated damage to the undead and demons.
May use their animas as protective shields.
May use their animas as cloaks against detection, and may mute their animas' display when using Essence.
May use their animas to sanctify oaths and contracts and to provide diplomatic immunity when dealing with spirits, demons and the Fair Folk.
